title: Playing clarinet and drums on the road; leaving for Las Vegas
summary: Johnson says he played clarinet and drums on the road, drums on the Pantages circuit. He left at about nineteen because his sister sent for him to help in her Las Vegas saloon, where he played piano day and night.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well no. Clarinet? Clarinet, drums. No I had drums, drums and clarinet. I done quite a bit of playing all right but not on big time you know like I was on the off and in Pantages' sake. I was playing clarinet on the off and I was playing drums on the Pantages.
How old were you when you left the road?

Oh I was about nineteen. Where did you leave? How come you left? What made you get the edge? I left on account of my sister, she sent for me to come out here. She was living out here? Yeah. In L.A.? No, in Las Vegas. And she had a saloon man, she wanted me to come out and help her. Did you play piano on the saloon? Yeah I played piano in the tin bar in the daytime, played piano at night.
